transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this course-approval meeting to order. We're here to review the proposed senior community-partnership capstone course for the fall term. As I understand it, the proposal currently describes this as a one-credit course assessed by a final reflective essay, combining supervised work with community organizations alongside academic reflection. Before we proceed, let's follow our standard round-robin checklist. I'd like to start with the faculty sponsor's report on any pilot and instructional findings. Could the faculty sponsor please share what you have?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Ellis. I need to share some important findings from my pilot work. I completed a six-week pilot with our community partners just this week, and the results indicate that students need 60 placement hours to achieve the course outcomes. Under our college policy of one credit per 30 placement hours, this course actually requires two credits, not one as currently proposed. Additionally, the pilot used a faculty-reviewed portfolio as the assessment method rather than a final reflective essay. I have the pilot report finished but have not yet attached it to the approval proposal — I'll make sure that's done right after this meeting.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Ellis. As registrar, I need to share the results of my state course inventory review, which I completed yesterday. This course must be coded BUS-198 and recorded with an S/U transcript notation rather than a letter-grade notation. I have not yet updated the draft catalog entry to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Ellis. As career-learning coordinator, I need to report on partner scheduling and capacity constraints. I confirmed by email this week that the participating community organizations can only host placements on Mondays and Wednesdays from 3:00 to 5:00 p.m., for a duration of six weeks. Additionally, the consortium can supervise no more than 12 students in the first term. I have not yet entered these details into the scheduling system, but I will do so promptly after this meeting.
transcript.speaker: A4
